Stake program instruction processing, state updates, delegation, merge, split, withdraw, and lockup logic.

# Purpose
This file implements the stake program execution logic for the Firedancer runtime. It decodes stake instructions, reads and writes stake account state with bincode, checks signer and sysvar requirements, and applies the rules for stake account life cycle operations such as [`initialize`](<#initialize>), [`authorize`](<#authorize>), [`delegate`](<#delegate>), [`split`](<#split>), [`merge`](<#merge>), [`withdraw`](<#withdraw>), [`deactivate`](<#deactivate>), [`set_lockup`](<#set_lockup>), [`move_stake`](<#move_stake>), and [`move_lamports`](<#move_lamports>). The main entry point is [`fd_stake_program_execute`](<#fd_stake_program_execute>), which dispatches each stake instruction and returns the proper executor error codes and custom stake errors.

The file also contains the stake state rules that the program uses to validate and update accounts. These rules cover lockup checks, delegation and redelegation limits, warmup and cooldown rate selection, stake history lookup, merge compatibility, delinquent deactivation checks, and weighted credit updates during merges. In addition, it writes the stake config account in [`fd_stake_program_config_init`](<#fd_stake_program_config_init>) and exposes helper APIs such as [`fd_stake_get_state`](<#fd_stake_get_state>) and [`fd_stake_activating_and_deactivating`](<#fd_stake_activating_and_deactivating>) for other code in the executor.
